name_reason: Conforms to data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: descriptor 'all_game_text_ptr' accurately states it is a pointer (_ptr) to the global (non-chapter, resource index 0) FDTXT.DAT text bank, distinct from data_fd2_current_chapter_text (per-chapter). No Ghidra address residue in the name (no hex suffix matching its own 0x53a7d or any data address); the trailing literal 0 appears only in the resource-index argument, not the name. Name correctly reflects both data type (pointer slot) and purpose.
purpose: Base pointer of the global FDTXT.DAT text bank (resource index 0) -- the engine-wide, non-chapter-specific text consumed by system/menu dialog.
logic_summary: uint32 address slot, zero-init (BSS). Written once at startup by the sole writer main @ 0x25BF4: data_fd2_all_game_text_ptr = fd2_load_dat_resource(FDTXT.DAT name, prior_value, 0), passing the prior value (NULL on first call) so the loader frees-then-reloads. Thereafter read-only at ~90 sites that pass it as the text_base argument of fd2_display_dialog_scene (shop buy/sell/give, save/load, revive, class promotion, recruitment, chapter-intro, level-up/status messages, ending). The dialog VM interprets the pointed-to buffer as a page-index header word table followed by an int16 dialog-opcode stream. Counterpart data_fd2_current_chapter_text @ 0x53A79 holds the per-chapter bank (resource = chapter_id+1).
element_semantics: Single 32-bit address slot holding the malloc'd FDTXT.DAT resource buffer base (resource index 0), per the engine-wide convention of storing DAT resource pointers as uint32 address slots rather than typed pointers.
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was correct but terse: it gave datatype + 'global FDTXT.DAT text bank (resource index 0)' + BSS init-state, but omitted the writer (main @ 0x25BF4 frees-then-reloads), the ~90 readers' role (text_base of fd2_display_dialog_scene), and the contrast with the per-chapter sibling data_fd2_current_chapter_text. Augmented for clarity; no inaccuracy.
notes: Sole writer = main @ 0x25BF4 (xref WRITE @ 0x25d14); ~90 READ xrefs, all into fd2_display_dialog_scene as text_base. is_const=false because of the game-side write. Ghidra data plate was empty (PLATE=null), so created a concise plate reflecting the src conclusion via run_script_inline cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...). No logic changed; name recorded as keep (no rename to apply in Stage 2).
